data.title: 爱丽丝 · 卢利特金黄麦浪中的驻足
data.description: 故乡卢利特村广袤无垠的秋日金黄麦田里，爱丽丝身穿天蓝亚麻朴素便裙配白围裙，麦穗在风中起伏如波浪，少女轻抚麦浪回望，眼神清澈而温柔。
data.action: touching wheat ears, breeze lifting hair ribbon, nostalgic gentle smile
data.lighting: radiant harvest sunset casting long golden shadows over crops
data.mood: deeply peaceful and poetic pastoral nostalgia
data.promptProse: Walking gently through shimmering golden wheatfields near her rural homeland in a simple country dress and apron, Alice brushes her fingertips across the ripening ears as the warm evening wind catches her blonde braid.
data.animaCaption: Alice smiling gently while strolling through golden sunset wheat fields.
